text:
Ashley: Heads-up — pricing proposal for next sprint: introduce a lightweight "micro" tier + prepaid burst-credit packs + a priority-lane add-on. Need PM/Eng/Finance/Sales alignment before Fri.

Jordan: +1. Sales/TAMs like micro for SMBs but need explicit limits and overage rules. Customers ask for rollover on credits frequently.

Sam: From infra POV: priority-lane implies tagging, queue priorities, and routing changes — nontrivial. Burst credits are easier if enforced at gateway. Per-route limits add routing complexity. Rough estimate: ~2w eng work + canary pipeline.

Priya: Finance note — billing model choice matters: prepaid packs (recognize revenue up front) vs postpaid overage (recurring revenue uncertain). Prepaid simplifies promos but need SKU definitions for invoicing.

Ashley: Initial strawman pricing (for discussion):
```
micro: $99/mo -> 100k tokens + 5 embeddings included
burst-pack-100k: $15 (prepaid)
priority-lane: $500/mo + metered surcharge above baseline
```
Open questions: rollover on unused burst credits? enterprise softcaps? minimum-term for priority-lane?

Jordan: Customers will push for rollover and per-seat variants. Also recommend min-commit (3mo) for priority-lane to sell SLA. Sales suggests 1 trial burst-pack free.

Sam: If we require priority-lane SLA, we must implement graceful fallback: auto-route to best-effort model variant when exhausted. The routing framework supports fallback; need feature flag + telemetry.

Priya: Contract clause proposal: if a customer consumes >500% of purchased burst volume for 3 consecutive months, we reserve right to require Dedicated contract or move to negotiated pricing. I'll draft wording.

deploy-bot: feature-flag created: `pricing.micro` in staging.

Ashley: Decisions for this sync:
- Approve micro tier experiment (price above)
- Burst credits = prepaid packs (no auto-rollover for initial experiment)
- Priority-lane = $500/mo + metered surcharge (precise surcharge to be modeled)

Action owners: Jordan -> customer pitch & FAQ; Sam -> eng RFC + canary plan; Priya -> SKU naming + contract clause + revenue modeling. Review Fri 10:00am.

Jordan: I'll draft the pitch + sample scripts for SDRs, target 2 pilot customers.

Sam: I'll post an engineering RFC with effort estimates and a canary checklist by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: I'll run revenue sensitivity and invoice SKU mockups, share by Thurs.

Ashley: Thanks all. @deploy-bot please ensure flag in staging + add telemetry hooks to capture priority-lane latency and rejection rates.

deploy-bot: ack — telemetry hooks queued on staging.

Ashley: Filing this as the canonical thread for the pricing experiment. We'll capture customer feedback in the pilot and reconvene after modeling + RFCs. :thumbsup:
